text:
Zenna: Hey folks — new hire MBP enrolled but I'm getting a persistent modal saying 'Untrusted Root Certificate: Redwood-CA' on boot and Keychain repeatedly asks for my password after each restart. Also System Settings > Privacy & Security still shows FileVault as 'Not enabled' even though the MDM profile says FV is enforced. First day blocker 😅. Anyone know what I should try?

Dina (IT): Welcome! Sorry about the friction. Quick Qs: which macOS build? Are you on home Wi‑Fi or connected to corp VPN? Can you paste the output of these commands: `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` and `profiles show`?

Zenna: I'm on macOS 13.6.3, home Wi‑Fi. Ran the first one, output below:
```
$ sudo profiles status -type enrollment
Enrolled: Yes
Profile identifier: com.redwood.mdm.enroll
Last check-in: 2026-11-03T14:12:08Z
Device compliance: pending (FileVault not enabled)
```
Also I see a profile in System Settings called 'Redwood Device Management' and the certificate "Redwood-CA" under System Roots with a red X when I open it in Keychain Access.

Matt K.: Sounds familiar — when the CA isn't trusted Keychain/OS won't let the MDM complete the FileVault enable flow. Two quick things to try: 1) In Keychain Access (open /Applications/Utilities/Keychain Access) find "Redwood-CA" under System Roots, double-click it and set "Trust: Always" for SSL if it looks legit. 2) If that doesn't work, remove duplicate MDM profiles and re-enroll.

Dina (IT): Don't set unknown certs to Always-trust without confirming — but this is our internal CA so it's OK here. Zenna, please try Matt's Keychain step and then run: `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and paste the output here. If still failing I can push a re-enroll from the console.

Zenna: Did the Trust change. Ran renew: 
```
$ sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
Renewing enrollment... success
Triggering device commands...
```
After reboot the Keychain prompt went away but FileVault still showed Not enabled.

Dina (IT): Thanks — I'm going to push a forced FileVault enable command from the MDM and a fresh enrollment profile. Tagging MDM Bot to run the re-provision.

MDM Bot: Re-provisioning enrollment profile for device id e3f6a9. Pushing FileVault enable command. Expected user action: reboot and let MDM complete enablement.

Zenna: Rebooted and now System Settings shows FileVault: On. No more cert popups and Keychain is stable. Everything working, I can proceed with onboarding. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Matt K.: Nice — welcome aboard! If you need temporary admin for any dev tools, ping IT with the list and how long.

Dina (IT): Closing the loop: we pushed re-enroll + FV enable. If anyone else hits this, try trusting the Redwood-CA in System Roots first, then do `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment`. If that fails, file a ticket and we'll re-provision.
